### Headline summary
- Major AI and tech stocks suffered a significant selloff, with the Magnificent Seven losing approximately $1 trillion in value. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-06/kospi-slides-after-us-rout-triggering-circuit-breaker-video), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-06/asia-hedge-funds-rich-investors-face-steep-losses-in-ai-selloff))
- OpenAI completed an $11 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, while Anthropic faces investor pressure to lower its IPO target. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-06/openai-completes-11-billion-portion-of-funding-at-1-25-trillion-value), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261106/p22#a261106p22), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261105/p60#a261105p60), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropics-november-ipo-plans-face-investor-push-for-better-terms/))
- Thinking Machines Lab released the Inkling 2 Small model, which is reported to lead western open-weight AI performance. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/thinking-machines-lab-is-closing-5-billion-new-round-2026-11), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/thinking-machines-lab-launches-inkling-2-small-with-open-weights-pending/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261105/p65#a261105p65), [Latent Space](https://latent.space/p/ainews-inkling-2-small-17a-594b-trained-in-68-hours-on-12t-tokens-beating-muse-spark/))

### Global AI and Tech Stock Selloff
Major technology and AI stocks experienced a significant market decline, with the Magnificent Seven losing approximately $1 trillion in value and Asian markets triggering circuit breakers. Investors shifted to bonds and hedge funds reported steep losses as the selloff deepened. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-06/kospi-slides-after-us-rout-triggering-circuit-breaker-video), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-06/asia-hedge-funds-rich-investors-face-steep-losses-in-ai-selloff), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-06/japan-s-nikkei-breaks-below-key-60-000-level-on-ai-selloff), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261106/p2#a261106p2))

### OpenAI closes $11 billion funding round
OpenAI completed an $11 billion portion of a new funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, with the total round potentially increasing to $20 billion. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-06/openai-completes-11-billion-portion-of-funding-at-1-25-trillion-value), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261106/p22#a261106p22))

### Anthropic IPO valuation faces investor pushback
Investors are pressuring Anthropic to lower its IPO valuation from the targeted $1.5 trillion to as low as $1.1 trillion following a tech stock selloff, though the company continues to plan a listing before Thanksgiving. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261105/p60#a261105p60), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropics-november-ipo-plans-face-investor-push-for-better-terms/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-anthropic-ipo-ambitions-investors-balk.html), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropics-1-5-trillion-ipo-hits-resistance-as-investors-balk-at-valuation/))

### Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling 2 Small
Thinking Machines Lab released the Inkling 2 Small model, which is reported to take the lead in western open-weight AI. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/thinking-machines-lab-is-closing-5-billion-new-round-2026-11), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/thinking-machines-lab-launches-inkling-2-small-with-open-weights-pending/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261105/p66#a261105p66), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/05/thinking-machines-inkling-2-small-release/))

### Impact of US Midterm Elections on AI Industry
Following the US midterm elections, the AI industry faces increased regulatory scrutiny and potential legislative hurdles, including new oversight of chip exports and data center construction. While some executives warn of a rough period due to political backlash, others maintain that data center buildouts will continue. ([AI Business](https://aibusiness.com/data-centers/enterprises-face-tougher-ai-regulatory-landscape), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://epyhia.com/meta-warns-midterm-backlash-threatens-ai-data-centers-goldman-sees-45), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261106/p6#a261106p6), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261106/p11#a261106p11))

### Jensen Huang Congressional Testimony
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was summoned to a closed-door briefing by House GOP leaders to address concerns regarding Chinese espionage and his interactions with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/05/technology/house-republicans-nvidia-jensen-huang-china.html), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/jensen-huang-asked-brief-congress-alleged-chinese-spy-plot), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/11/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-summoned-by-congress-over-chinese-espionage-concerns/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/jensen-huang-kongress-kontakte-mutmassliche-china-spionin-3809506))

### DOJ Indicts Three for AI CEO Impersonation Fraud
The US Department of Justice has indicted three foreign nationals for allegedly using AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys at major law firms in a fraud scheme exceeding $129 million. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261106/p17#a261106p17), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/06/ai-ceo-impersonation-theft))

### OpenAI AI agent finds Linux kernel vulnerabilities
OpenAI's Aardvark agent identified 948 unique local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel, a task that cost less than a standard bug bounty. ([DEV Community](https://dev.to/anoymask/openais-linux-kernel-research-948-unique-lpes-and-candidate-patches-4hd3), [DEV Community](https://dev.to/ahtisham_lala_a1af953f29b/openais-ai-just-found-948-ways-to-get-root-on-linux-and-it-cost-less-than-a-bug-bounty-360))
